ॡ: ॡ The long vowel corresponding to the preceding short one, Lri or Li.

ॡ aptote. 	 1. A divine female. 	 2. The female nature. 	 3. A mother. 	 m. (ॡः) A name of SIVA. 	 f. (ॡः) 	 1. The mother of the demons. 	 2. The mother of the all-bestowing cow. ind. A mystical letter used once or repeatedly in many Mantras or mystical formulæ. The letters ॠ and ऌ are employed in the same manner: they have ap-parently no signification, but are personified and invested with marvellous properties in the Tantras.
